content_sections.heading: DM&HO Khammam Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is done on Merit Basis and based on the following criteria: Total marks are 100, of which 90 marks are allotted based on marks obtained in the qualifying examination, and 10 marks are awarded for age (weight-age for age reckoned from 18 years of age, giving 0.5 marks for one completed year of age with a maximum of 10 marks as on 01-07-2026). Selections will follow the Rule of Reservation (RoR), Presidential Orders, and SC-ST reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DM&HO Khammam
content_sections.text: Download the application form along with instructions from the official website https://khammam.telangana.gov.in between 08.10.2026 to 13.10.2026. Fill out the downloaded application form completely. Enclose self-attested copies of all required certificates. Enclose the original Demand Draft for the prescribed application fee drawn in favor of the “District Medical & Health Officer, Khammam”. Submit the filled application form in person or through registered post to the O/o District Medical & Health Office, F1, I.D.O.C, V. Venkatayapalem, Khammam on or before 13.10.2026 till 5.00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: S.S.C / Date of Birth Certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks Memos of all years (qualifying examination) Registration Certificates of respective Councils Latest Community Certificate / EWC Certificate / Ex-Servicemen / NCC / Physically Handicapped certificate, if applicable Study certificates from 4th class to 10th class (or residence certificate from Tahsildhar/MRO for private study) PH certificate, if claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant certificates for Ex-service Men Quota Registration Certificate from the concerned Medical Council / Nursing Council / Para Medical Board / Other relevant authority 1 Photograph duly pasted on the application form

content_sections.heading: DM&HO Khammam Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected, and the District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays. Selected candidates must maintain the Headquarters and positions are not transferable. The appointment is on an outsourcing or contract basis for a period of 1 year or till actual need ceases, whichever is earlier. No TA/DA will be paid for attending interviews. Appointees will work under the overall administrative control of CH&FW and MD, NHM. The termination notice shall be a 30-day period from either side. The posts are temporary and not permanent/regular Government posts. Employment is subject to disciplinary/codal rules.

faq.question: Q1. What is the DM&HO Khammam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The DM&HO Khammam Recruitment 2026 is a notification issued to fill 99 vacant posts under the National Health Mission (NHM) on a contract and out-sourcing basis in Khammam district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 99 vacancies are available across various medical, nursing, and support categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DM&HO Khammam recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 13-10-2026 till 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in person or through registered post to the O/o District Medical & Health Office, Khammam.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01.07.2026, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: Selection is done on a merit basis, allotting 90 marks based on marks obtained in the qualifying examination and 10 marks awarded for age, following reservation rules and presidential orders.

faq.question: Q7. Are these permanent government posts?
faq.answer: No, these posts are purely temporary on an outsourcing or contract basis for 1 year or until actual need ceases.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application fee Demand Draft be drawn?
faq.answer: The Demand Draft must be drawn in favor of the “District Medical & Health Officer, Khammam”, payable at Khammam.
